declarations.name: AuiLineChart

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (aria-describedby).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for values in tooltips, labels, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Shared x values, one per point: strings (category axis), numbers (linear axis), or instants (time axis). Numbers and instants must be ascending.

inputs.name: series
inputs.description: Series: { id, label, values: (number | null)[], color?: 1-8 }. values has exactly one entry per x value; null, NaN, and infinities are gaps.

inputs.name: area
inputs.description: Fill the area between each line and the zero baseline (includes zero in the domain).

inputs.name: xType
inputs.description: Axis type. Default: inferred from the first x value.

inputs.name: xAxis
inputs.description: X axis title and approximate tick count (2-20).

inputs.name: yAxis
inputs.description: Y axis title, tick count, fixed domain, and zero inclusion (default true with area).

inputs.name: formatX
inputs.description: Custom x text for tooltips, labels, the table, and the summary.

inputs.name: timeFormat
inputs.description: Date format of time x values. Default: chosen from the data resolution (year, month, day, minute, second).

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Zoom and pan along x: a Zoom toolbar (Zoom in, Zoom out, Reset zoom), +/= and - and 0 keys on a focused point, arrow keys past the window edge pan, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag to pan a zoomed chart, Shift + drag to select a range. Turning it off resets the window.

inputs.name: annotations
inputs.description: Reference lines ({ type: 'line', axis: 'x' | 'y', value, label?, tone? }) and bands ({ type: 'band', axis, from, to, label?, tone? }); tone: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'. x values are category labels or indexes, numbers, or epoch ms (time axes); y values are numbers. Drawn under the marks (aria-hidden); listed in the accessible summary.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: auto: legend when there is more than one series (pie charts: always).

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback with the exact data: behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Dash patterns and texture fills so series never differ by color alone. Off by default (plain colors); always on in forced colors. Turn it on when series are told apart by color alone (grouped or stacked series, multi-slice pies) and no labels carry the distinction (WCAG 1.4.1).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: markers
inputs.description: Point markers: auto when points are at least 12 px apart; focus shows only the hovered or focused point. Isolated points always show a marker.

inputs.name: crosshair
inputs.description: Vertical crosshair line (aria-hidden) at the hovered or focused x value.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number, date, and message locale.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone for time axes, tooltips, labels, and the table.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the category/x axis, the value axis side, and Left/Right arrow keys.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Ids of series (or slices) hidden initially; update() replaces the hidden set.

models.name: zoomRange
models.description: Visible x window { from, to } in data units (category index, number, or epoch ms for time axes); null shows everything. Clamped to the data and to at least two points. Applied without an aui-zoom event; use with zoom: true (the toolbar and keys need it).

outputs.name: seriesToggled
outputs.description: The user toggled a legend entry (pointer or keyboard). Not emitted for update() or setSeriesVisible().

outputs.name: zoomed
outputs.description: The user changed the visible window (toolbar, keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag pan, Shift + drag selection). x is null when showing everything. Not emitted for the zoomRange option or when the window does not change.

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide a series (slice) programmatically; emits no event.

accessibility.pattern: SVG chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription) of role="img" data points with roving focus; data table fallback (native table). Follows the WAI Complex Images tutorial (short name plus long description) and the roving tabindex technique of WAI-ARIA APG.

limitations: x values are shared by all series; each series needs exactly one value per x value.
Straight line segments only (no curve smoothing).
Axis labels are sized by estimate (about 0.6 em per character, 1 em for wide characters), so unusual fonts may truncate earlier or later than needed.
The zoom window keeps at least two points visible; zoomRange is clamped to the data.
